name: @tsci/AnasSarkiz.smart-nema14-motor-controller--01a0fd9b
description: STEPPERONLINE 14HM11-0404S controller: saved native copper and Codex Cloud handoff; incomplete routing prototype, not fabrication ready

scripts.build: bun run validate:imports && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --pcb-png --pcb-svgs --schematic-svgs
scripts.snapshot: bun run validate:imports && tsci snapshot index.circuit.tsx
scripts.format: biome format --write index.circuit.tsx routing-review.circuit.tsx assembly.circuit.tsx mounted-assembly.circuit.tsx controller-preview.circuit.tsx src scripts mechanical/viewer.js mechanical/design-constraints.json package.json tsconfig.json tscircuit.config.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format index.circuit.tsx routing-review.circuit.tsx assembly.circuit.tsx mounted-assembly.circuit.tsx controller-preview.circuit.tsx src scripts mechanical/viewer.js mechanical/design-constraints.json package.json tsconfig.json tscircuit.config.json biome.json
scripts.preview:schematic: bun run validate:imports && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --disable-pcb --schematic-svgs --schematic-png && node scripts/render-schematic-sheets.mjs
scripts.preview:viewer: bun build mechanical/viewer.js --target browser --minify --outfile mechanical/viewer.bundle.js && .mechanical-venv/bin/python mechanical/build-viewer.py

author: AnasSarkiz
